using CUDA
using JACC
using JSON3

"""
Minimal test kernel: element-wise vector addition on the GPU, with two
interchangeable implementations selected via the "engine" input field.

Input JSON (argv[1]):
    {"a": [1,2,3], "b": [10,20,30], "engine": "cuda"}   # or "jacc" (default: "cuda")
Output JSON (stdout):
    {"result": [11,22,33], "device": "<GPU name>", "engine": "cuda"}

This exists purely to validate the pipeline end-to-end (container ->
RunPod scheduler -> GPU worker -> Julia -> CUDA.jl/JACC.jl -> result back).
Swap the kernel body out once the plumbing is confirmed working.
"""


# --- Raw CUDA.jl kernel (vendor-specific, lowest-level control) ---
function vadd_kernel!(y, a, b)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i <= length(y)
        @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
    end
    return nothing
end

function run_cuda(a_host, b_host)
    n = length(a_host)
    a_dev = CuArray(a_host)
    b_dev = CuArray(b_host)
    y_dev = CUDA.zeros(Float32, n)

    threads = 256
    blocks = cld(n, threads)
    @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks vadd_kernel!(y_dev, a_dev, b_dev)
    CUDA.synchronize()

    return Array(y_dev)
end

# --- JACC.jl kernel (portable across CUDA/AMDGPU/oneAPI/Metal/threads,
#     backend chosen at image-build time via JACC.set_backend) ---
function vadd_kernel_jacc!(i, y, a, b)
    @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
end

function run_jacc(a_host, b_host)
    n = length(a_host)
    a_dev = JACC.array(a_host)
    b_dev = JACC.array(b_host)
    y_dev = JACC.zeros(Float32, n)

    JACC.@parallel_for range=n vadd_kernel_jacc!(y_dev, a_dev, b_dev)

    return Array(y_dev)
end

function main()
    if length(ARGS) < 1
        println(stderr, "Usage: julia kernel.jl '<json input>'")
        exit(1)
    end

    input = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
    a_host = Float32.(input.a)
    b_host = Float32.(input.b)
    engine = haskey(input, :engine) ? String(input.engine) : "cuda"

    if !CUDA.functional()
        println(JSON3.write(Dict("error" => "CUDA is not functional on this worker (no GPU visible or driver issue)")))
        exit(1)
    end

    y_host = engine == "jacc" ? run_jacc(a_host, b_host) : run_cuda(a_host, b_host)
    dev_name = CUDA.name(CUDA.device())

    println(JSON3.write(Dict("result" => y_host, "device" => dev_name, "engine" => engine)))
end

main()
